prompts.dev2: Marlo just told me to add a Gift Card feature to this Sprint, today. I said okay, but... sorry, was that wrong?
prompts.dev1: Marlo wants a Gift Card feature squeezed into this Sprint. Today. Do I just say yes?

answers.text: Yes, Marlo is the boss. Add it.
answers.feedback: Adding work mid-Sprint can break the Sprint Goal.

answers.text: Keep the Sprint Goal, and put the Gift Card on the Product Backlog for the next Planning.
answers.feedback: Right. The goal stays steady and the idea isn't lost.

answers.text: Add it only if you finish early.
answers.feedback: Closer, but it still sneaks scope into the Sprint without a conversation.
Shutting out the Product Owner doesn't help anyone.
